newsitem.title: USA: ESS Technology president Martin to leave.
newsitem.headline: ESS Technology president Martin to leave.

text.p: ESS Technology Inc said Friday that Herbert Martin is leaving his post as president and chief operating officer.
The company said Chairman and Chief Executive Fred Chan will assume the president's duties, adding that Martin will remain a company director and also serve as a company consultant.

The company said Robert Blair has been promoted from vice president of operations to executive vice president of operations and will expand his duties to include certain functions previously handled by Martin.
This will allow Chan "to continue to focus his attention on corporate strategy, acquisitions, and business development," the company said in a release.
